established_contexts: Frozen C158208 signed through-highway junction with yield-sign control, no stop line or near-side crosswalk, and nearest-view branch selected for the original-source recording.

variable_parameters.name: sign_type
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: stop or yield sign with original Native sign and face readback

variable_parameters.name: stopping_reference
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: stop line, near-side crosswalk or nearest-view location with original evidence

variable_parameters.name: through_vehicle_state
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: approaching, already entered or absent through-highway actor staging

variable_parameters.name: commanded_approach_speed
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: positive engineering m/s target; not a legal slowing cutoff

variable_parameters.name: commanded_view_speed
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: positive engineering m/s target at the constructed view bracket

variable_parameters.name: through_highway_sight_clear
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: original sampled sight-ray history; human visibility unresolved

variable_parameters.name: ego_in_intersection
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: original ego-body overlap with sourced junction

variable_parameters.name: commanded_through_speed
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: positive engineering m/s target for an approaching through-highway actor; not a legal hazard threshold

variable_parameters.name: authored_sign_hOffset_rad
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: authored OpenDRIVE yield-sign face offset in radians; original Native sign readback required

variable_parameters.name: native_sign_rotation_deg
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: original Native yield-sign face rotation in degrees; visibility remains observational

variable_parameters.name: view_occluder_center_y_m
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: authored roadside streetbarrier center across the 12, 15 and 18 m physical contrast

variable_parameters.name: through_lane_ray_target_xy_m
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: authored through-highway ray target coordinates in metres; original lane and camera review required
